title: CLI P0 Subprocess Contract Tests v1
mutation_isolation: All tests use REPO_ROOT as working directory. No temp directory cwd changes (script paths are relative). No live GitHub or network calls. Environment variable RIG_LIVE_AUTH_TESTS is stripped. GitHub scripts with --summary produce reports without attempting mutation. Live PR write without triple-flag gate stays safe.
remaining_untested_cases: Subprocess tests on gated scripts with real ReceiptStore (requires FilesystemReceiptStore path config)
Subprocess tests with actual mutation result (requires enterprise registry populated)
Live GitHub PR mutation end-to-end (requires real GitHub auth, deferred to GitHub Trust Spine)
Publish PR execute-remote with governance pass (requires HTTPS transport to GitHub)
Tenant admin register/grant/revoke with governance pass (requires populated tenant registry and approval receipt)
Fleet admin start/stop/restart with governance pass (requires FleetController backends)
